_meta.title: Flat single-sided wafer / disc-tumbler depth & space reference
_meta.purpose: Cabinet, office-furniture and toolbox key specs, in the same shape as js/keys/blanks.js `spec` objects. Reference data (the 'have and not need' set) that Item A (cabinet-key support) draws its verified blanks from.
_meta.units: inches (convert at the mesh boundary with IN_TO_MM, like blanks.js)
_meta.datum: Root depth = height of the cut bottom above the blade BACK. Deeper cut -> smaller root depth. Same datum blanks.js uses.
_meta.readDirection: ALL of these read bow->tip, which matches this app's numbering (bow->tip). No reversal needed, unlike BEST/SFIC.
_meta.source: Tyler J. Thomas, 'Key Bitting Specifications' (2025), section 7 'Wafer' — docs/key-refs/KeyBittingSpecifications-TylerJThomas.pdf. Printed page in each entry's `srcPage`.
_meta.verified: Transcribed verbatim from the compendium and double-checked. NOT yet cut-tested. Mark a blank `verified: true` in blanks.js only after a test cut.

fields.increment: root-depth change per one-unit code step (in) [depthStep]
fields.rootCut: flat width at the bottom of a cut (in) [cutFlat]
fields.tfc: shoulder/tip datum -> centre of cut position 1 (in) [firstCut]
fields.positions: max number of cut positions the series uses
fields.depths: ordered [label, rootDepthInches]; label is the manufacturer's depth digit
fields.category: office-cabinet | toolbox — what these locks are actually on

_meta.blindCodeWarning: These specs give depth & space only. A stamped catalog code (T05, 318, ES202, F36 ...) is a BLIND code, not a cut code — converting it to a bitting needs the manufacturer's code book, which is separate and often restricted. For a key you own, measure it once (app photo or calipers) and record the resulting bitting; see WAFER-CABINET-KEYS.md.

national_ss.name: National Disc Tumbler (Single Sided)
national_ss.notes: Very common on US office furniture / file cabinets (CompX National). Some factory codes use different depth numbers; substitute 0=1, 2=2, 4=3, 6=4. HPC C37/P37, ITL 316, Blackhawk Card 192, DSD #052.

compx_y000.name: Snap-On Toolbox (CompX Y000)
compx_y000.notes: Toolbox / tool-chest wafer lock. Factory combinations use only depths 2, 3, 4. Cut on CompX D8777 blanks; existing keys can be duplicated on Ilco 1527 indexed on the centre warding grooves. DSD #379.

chicago_dt.name: Chicago Disc Tumbler
chicago_dt.notes: Chicago Lock cabinet/cam locks. HPC C5/P5L,P5R, ITL 93, Blackhawk Card 170, DSD #6.

corbin_dt.name: Corbin Disc Tumbler
corbin_dt.notes: HPC C11, ITL 281, Blackhawk Card 173, DSD #12.

dexter_dt.name: Dexter Disc Tumbler
dexter_dt.notes: Identical to Briggs & Stratton. HPC C4/P5L, ITL 144, Blackhawk Card 152, DSD #5.

eagle_dt.name: Eagle Disc Tumbler
eagle_dt.notes: Eagle A63A series (0750 keyway) uses the same depths with TFC .090 / BCC .093. ITL 270, Blackhawk Card 176, DSD #27.

illinois_ss.name: Illinois Disc Tumbler (Single Sided)
illinois_ss.tfcNote: TFC varies; older versions increased it to .150
illinois_ss.notes: HPC C29/P29L,P29R, ITL 414, Blackhawk Card 187, DSD #44.

hudson_dt.name: Hudson Disc Tumbler
hudson_dt.depthsNote: Irregular / master-keyed depth set with half-step (W/10, X/7) designators — NOT a uniform increment. Do not model with a linear depthStep; use the explicit table.
hudson_dt.notes: Applies to Hudson EL, GA, GB, GG, HC, HL, HU, LL, MA, MB, MM, W, X series. Hudson also clones other makers' locks using their original depth/spacing. HPC CX32/PX32, ITL 224, Blackhawk Card 181, DSD #40.
